glovashu.label: glovashu
glovashu.why: No GLOVASHU_HOST/GLOVASHU_TOKEN in .env, so there is no second workspace to ask. Asking instead whether glovashu is a catalog here -- which answers probe 1 conclusively in the negative if it is.

conclusion.evidence: glovashu is a CATALOG under the primary metastore
conclusion.means:
glovashu is a second catalog, not a second metastore. D2D needs two metastores: the recipient is identified by a sharing identifier cloud:region:uuid where the uuid IS the metastore id, so a catalog has no sharing identifier of its own and there is no far side to name.
CONSEQUENCE: T-19 and the E-2 proposal are NOT_RUN, with 'only one metastore available on this tier' as the stated reason. Record it; do not simulate it. The D2O half (OSS provider) is unaffected and still carries T-20 and T-23.

databricks_auth_recipient.why: Probe 1 did not establish two distinct metastores.
